title: Send email with Loops
description: Send Managed Better Auth sign-in codes and links as Loops transactional emails, sync new users to Loops, and send Loops events that start workflows.

environment.name: LOOPS_API_KEY
environment.description: An API key from app.loops.so/settings?page=api. Keep it on the server.

environment.name: LOOPS_OTP_SIGNIN_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for sign-in codes. The email uses the otpCode data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_OTP_VERIFICATION_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for email verification codes. The email uses the otpCode data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_OTP_PASSWORD_RESET_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for password reset codes. The email uses the otpCode data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_MAGIC_LINK_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for magic sign-in links. The email uses the magicLinkUrl data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_VERIFY_EMAIL_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for email verification links. The email uses the verificationUrl data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_RESET_PASSWORD_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
environment.description: Transactional ID of the Loops email for password reset links. The email uses the resetPasswordUrl data variable.

environment.name: LOOPS_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Only for the /send-event route. Callers send this random token of at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32, as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Neon Function URLs are public, so the route requires it.

operations.title: Managed Better Auth webhook
operations.description: Receives signed Managed Better Auth webhooks. Sends send.otp and send.magic_link as Loops transactional emails, creates a Loops contact on user.created, and sends a joinedOrganization event on organization.invitation.accepted.

operations.title: Send a Loops event
operations.description: POST an email or userId, an eventName, and optional eventProperties to start a Loops workflow from your backend. An optional Idempotency-Key header is passed to Loops.
